# Harrison Rogers

> Harrison Rogers is a New Zealand AI Integrated Software Engineer. harrisonrogers.dev is his public portfolio and provides a read-only REST API and MCP server for agents to retrieve his professional profile, projects, and career history.

## Developer resources

- [Harrison Rogers Developer API and MCP Documentation](https://harrisonrogers.dev/developers): Human-readable API and MCP integration guide
- [Harrison Rogers OpenAPI Specification](https://harrisonrogers.dev/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the public REST API
- [Harrison Rogers API Directory](https://harrisonrogers.dev/api): JSON index of public endpoints
- [Harrison Rogers MCP Server](https://harrisonrogers.dev/mcp): Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint; send JSON-RPC requests with HTTP POST
- [Harrison Rogers MCP Manifest](https://harrisonrogers.dev/.well-known/mcp.json): Machine-readable MCP server metadata
- [Full Agent Reference](https://harrisonrogers.dev/llms-full.txt): Complete API and MCP usage details

## Public data

- [Professional Profile](https://harrisonrogers.dev/api/profile): Skills, location, summary, and public contact links
- [Projects](https://harrisonrogers.dev/api/projects): Personal and professional software projects
- [Career](https://harrisonrogers.dev/api/career): Public employment history
